landing.headline: Verify. Authenticate. Succeed.
landing.subtitle: A secure, centralized platform for managing and verifying academic examinations. Select your role to continue.

login.adminSubtitle: Sign in to manage students, exams, and attendance verification.
login.studentSubtitle: Enter your registration number to access your student dashboard.
login.invigilatorSubtitle: Authorized invigilators can sign in to review attendance and verification status.

dashboard.step1: Go to Exams and add your exam units first.
dashboard.step2: Go to Register and add each student with a clear face photo. A QR code is auto-generated.
dashboard.step3: At the exam, go to Verify — scan or type the student QR code, look at the camera, click Verify.
dashboard.step4: Check Attendance for the complete digital log.

studentDashboard.subtitle: Access your portal, download your exam QR code, and review upcoming exams.
studentDashboard.noUpcomingExams: No upcoming exams are scheduled yet. Check back later or contact your lecturer for updates.

studentPortal.pageTitle: Student Portal — Download Your QR Code
studentPortal.description: Enter your registration number to view and download your examination QR code. You can do this at any time before your exam.
studentPortal.fieldHelp: This is the registration number you used when you were registered in the system.
studentPortal.errorMessage: Registration number not found. Please check and try again.
studentPortal.successMessage: ✓ Found — your QR code is shown on the right.
studentPortal.helpDescription: Contact the Registrar's Office or your exam invigilator. Make sure your registration was completed by the admin before you search.
studentPortal.showQRCodeMessage: Show this QR code to the invigilator at the exam venue entrance. Save it to your phone or print it out.
studentPortal.noExamsScheduled: No exams scheduled yet. Check back closer to exam time.
studentPortal.placeholderMessage: Enter your registration number on the left to view and download your QR code.

register.fullNamePlaceholder: As it appears on your university ID
register.photoHelp: Upload a clear, front-facing photo with good lighting. This photo is used for face recognition during exams.

attendance.noRecords: No verification records yet. Use the Verify page to start verifying students.

verify.step2Help: Scan the student QR code (it auto-fills), or type manually.
verify.step3Help: Student looks at camera. Click the button. The system captures their face and checks it.
verify.liveCameraHelp: Make sure the student faces the camera clearly.
verify.cameraDenied: Camera access was denied. Please allow camera permissions and reload the page.
verify.enterRegistrationError: Please enter or scan a registration number first.
verify.cameraInitializing: Camera is still initialising. Please wait 2 seconds and try again.
verify.cameraBlank: Camera frame appears blank. Please wait for the camera to fully load, then try again.
verify.connectionError: Connection error. Make sure the server is running.
verify.downloadBlocked: Automatic download blocked. The image will open in a new tab. Right-click → "Save image as" to download it.
verify.downloadBlockedSecurity: Automatic download blocked by browser security. The QR image will open in a new tab. Right-click it and choose "Save image as" to download.

studentCard.successDescription: This QR code is the student's exam entry pass. Download it now or access it later via the Student Portal.

invigilatorDashboard.subtitle: Monitor verification activity and review attendance records from one secure dashboard.
invigilatorDashboard.summaryHelp: This includes all recorded verification events. Use the Attendance Report to view details and recent entries.
invigilatorDashboard.startSession: Start a new student verification session
